proposals.evidence: Propose ordered inside + hand: DEDR698 explicitly gives Malayalam uḷḷam inside/mind, matching the current *uḷḷ-am parent, and DEDR2023 gives kai/kay/kayyi hand. Survey uḷḷam-kai and assimilated uḷḷaŋ-kai/uḷḷaŋ-gai retain both constituents. This uses the actual uḷḷam formation; it does not override the separate hold on house words under this narrower parent.

proposals.evidence: DEDR474 and3918 explicitly document Tamil/Malayalam iru-patu/iru-vatu twenty, Kannada irpattu/ippattu, Kodagu iru-vadï and Kota irvād. Propose ordered two × ten components for the selected southern survey forms, preserving assimilated pp/bb, initial-glide variants and final vowels. Minority-lect forms are comparative extensions; neighbouring Gondi/Gadaba/Konda contact-sensitive numeral sets are excluded.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3918 explicitly gives Tamil paṉṉ-iraṇṭu/paṉṉaṇṭu twelve, the Kannada pann- combining form of ten and Kodagu panneraṇḍï; DEDR474 supplies two and the corresponding numeral formations. Propose ordered ten + two, retaining assimilation, Kannada h-/zero-initial variants and the survey vowel notation. These are whole-numeral comparative analyses, with no truncation of source responses; contact-sensitive Gondi/Gadaba/Konda sets are excluded.
